question: Will NVIDIA officially announce Jensen Huang's resignation or removal as CEO before Jan 1, 2027?

model.prompt_context:

- "Yes": Wins if NVIDIA makes an official public announcement — via its corporate newsroom, investor relations site, or an SEC filing — strictly after 2026-11-09T16:32:33.061Z and at or before 2026-12-31T20:00:00.000Z, confirming that Jensen Huang has resigned, been removed, or will cease to hold the role of CEO.
- "No": Wins if no such official announcement is made strictly after 2026-11-09T16:32:33.061Z and at or before 2026-12-31T20:00:00.000Z.
